features.name: Experience Personalization Dashboard
features.summary: Dashboard for older adults to adjust readability, visual comfort, navigation complexity, feedback, and confirmation behavior.
capabilities: Accessible labels, names, focus states, and live-region feedback

features.name: Simplified Activity Organizer
features.summary: Clear task organizer for academic and professional activities with guided steps, reminders, completion feedback, and history.

features.name: User Profile and Persistent Settings
features.summary: Profile and settings area that stores and restores accessibility and reminder preferences across sessions.
capabilities: Use accessible defaults when no preferences exist

features.name: Clean Architecture Foundation
features.summary: Layered architecture that keeps domain and application logic independent from UI, storage, Zustand, and framework details.

features.name: Material UI Accessible Theme
features.summary: Material UI theme generated from DESIGN.md tokens and runtime accessibility preferences.

features.name: Accessibility Validation for Older Adults
features.summary: Validation of accessibility requirements through ARIA premises, keyboard navigation, focus management, contrast, spacing, and reduced motion.

features.name: CI/CD Foundation
features.summary: GitHub Actions workflow for Node.js 20+ that installs dependencies, runs lint, tests, and production build.
capabilities: Run on pull requests to main

features.name: Activity Organizer Multi-Zone Readiness
features.summary: Prepare seniorease-web as the primary Next.js zone for a future Activity Organizer zone routed through Multi-Zones.
capabilities: Activity Organizer has clear public contracts
Remote subsection embedding through Web Components
JavaScript properties for complex widget input data
HTML attributes for simple widget configuration
Local fallback when activity zone is unavailable
Documentation for future Next.js Multi-Zones configuration
